args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Travel documents (passport/ID, flight tickets, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Travel insurance information

Clothing:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Light, breathable clothing (t-shirts, shorts, sundresses)
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Hat with brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

Beach Day (Waikiki Beach - June 11):
- Beach towel
- Beach bag
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkel gear (or plan to rent)

Snorkeling (Hanauma Bay - June 12):
- Rash guard/swim shirt for sun protection
- Water shoes
- Underwater camera (optional)

Hiking (Diamond Head - June 13):
- Sturdy hiking shoes
- Hiking socks
- Lightweight backpack
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen (reef-safe)
- Insect repellent

Pearl Harbor Visit (June 14):
- Respectful attire (covered shoulders and knees)
- Comfortable walking shoes

North Shore Road Trip (June 15):
- Car adapter for phone charging
- Cooler for drinks/snacks
- Beach gear for potential stops

Luau Experience (June 16):
- Hawaiian shirt or island-themed attire (optional but fun)
- Comfortable clothes for sitting

Spa Day (June 17):
- Spa-appropriate swimwear if using pool/hot tub
- Flip-flops

Kayaking (Kailua Beach - June 18):
- Quick-dry clothing
- Water shoes
- Waterproof bag for belongings

Shopping (Ala Moana Center - June 19):
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Reusable shopping bags

Health & Personal Care:
- Reef-safe sunscreen (minimum SPF 30)
- Aloe vera gel for sunburns
- Prescription medications
- Basic first aid kit
- Toiletries
- Hand sanitizer
- Face masks (if needed)

Electronics:
- Universal power adapter
- Portable power bank
- Headphones

Miscellaneous:
- Reusable water bottle
- Snacks for day trips
- Small backpack/day bag
- Books or e-reader for downtime
- Travel pillow for flights
